name: IP Address in Host
description: The use of IP addresses is common to hide the server's identity and evade filters.

name: URL is excessively long
description: Extremely long URLs can hide malicious parameters or confuse the user.

name: Risk domain extension
description: The domain uses an extension (.zip, .tk) frequently used for phishing attacks.

name: Social engineering keywords
description: Terms such as 'login', 'verify' or 'secure' were detected in a suspicious URL structure, indicating a possible attempt at deception.

name: Punycode (Homograph Attack)
description: The domain uses Punycode to display characters that look like normal letters to spoof legitimate brands.

name: Excessive Subdomains
description: An unusually high number of subdomains is often used to push the real domain out of the user's view on mobile browsers.

name: Brand Typosquatting
description: The domain is visually similar to a major monitored brand, but has slight misspellings designed to deceive the user.

name: URL Shortener Used
description: A URL shortening service is being used, which hides the true destination of the link.

name: Brand in Subdomain
description: A monitored brand name appears in the subdomain, but the actual registered domain belongs to someone else.

name: Credential Obfuscation (@)
description: The URL uses the '@' symbol, a deprecated method for passing credentials that browsers often ignore, redirecting the user to the host after the symbol.

name: Double File Extension
description: The URL ends with a double extension (like .pdf.exe). This is a known tactic to disguise malicious executables as harmless documents.

name: Insecure HTTP Protocol
description: The link uses unencrypted HTTP. Any data sent (like passwords) can be intercepted.
